title: Ball Corporation to Present at Baird's 2026 Global Industrial Conference

WESTMINSTER, Colo.


, Oct. 29, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Ball Corporation (NYSE: BALL), the leading global provider in sustainable aluminum packaging for beverage, personal care and household products, will present at the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference on November 12, 2026.


Ron Lewis, chief executive officer, and Dan Rabbitt, senior vice president and chief financial officer, are scheduled to speak at 7:55 a.m. Central Time. To listen to the presentation via live webcast, visit the following link:[Ball Corporation Live Webcast](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4809155-1&h=1082838838&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2F8hgfu2da8CspZvFv8aZFfm%2FaD8MHSxzXsPwb9qgrNwry4&a=Ball+Corporation+Live+Webcast)


**About Ball Corporation**


Ball Corporation (NYSE: BALL) is the global leader in sustainable aluminum packaging solutions, serving a robust portfolio of customers in the beverage, personal care and household products industries. With 16,000 employees in more than 65 manufacturing plants and facilities worldwide, Ball reported 2025 net sales of $13.16 billion. For more information, visit[Ball.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4809155-1&h=3158429085&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ball.com%2F&a=Ball.com) and connect with us on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4809155-1&h=4046762265&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4463445-1%26h%3D1654705636%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.linkedin.com%252Fcompany%252Fballcorporation%252Fposts%252F%253FfeedView%253Dall%26a%3DLinkedIn&a=LinkedIn) .
